title: Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour Opens European Leg at Estadi Olímpic Barcelona — Bad Bunny's First European Stadium Shows in Six Years
detail: Bad Bunny opened the European stadium leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour tonight at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona, Spain — his first European stadium concerts in six years. Both Barcelona nights (May 22–23) sold out, with the 54,000-capacity Estadi Olímpic hosting what Spanish media called 'Spain's biggest tour of the year.' Bad Bunny arrived in Barcelona on May 21, confirmed by Euronews and local press. The production features 360-degree scenography, over two hours of performance spanning reggaetón, Latin trap, salsa, and bomba, and a second intimate stage called 'La Casita' allowing closer fan interaction — a signature element of the DtMF tour run since its November 2025 launch. The Barcelona concerts mark the beginning of a European stadium swing that continues in Lisbon and Madrid. The European leg follows a sprawling run across six continents — including 30-night residency in Puerto Rico, stadium dates across Latin America, Australia, Japan, and South Korea — that deliberately excluded all U.S. cities in response to ICE immigration enforcement actions, a stance Bad Bunny has maintained throughout the tour. The opening night comes one day after the global launch of his Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' 150-piece collection, and with 'DtMF' holding 59 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs — the all-time chart record.
